segments.name: Design Automation
segments.description: Provides EDA software, hardware, simulation and analysis solutions and services used by engineers to design, verify and test chips and electronic systems.
segments.evidence: Our Design Automation segment includes the EDA, Ansys and Other revenue groups.

segments.name: Design IP
segments.description: Provides pre-designed semiconductor IP components and related services that chip designers use to reduce development risk and speed time to market.
segments.evidence: Design IP includes our interface, foundation, security, and embedded processor IP, IP subsystems, and IP implementation services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for software licenses (typically time-based TSL subscriptions of two to three years), hardware, support and services, plus royalties when customers sell products incorporating Synopsys IP.
revenueModel.evidence: The duration of our TSL contracts is generally two to three years, though it may vary for specific arrangements.

changes.text: In 2025, Synopsys completed its acquisition of Ansys, adding simulation and analysis products to the Design Automation segment.
changes.evidence: With ANSYS, Inc, (Ansys) now part of Synopsys, we can maximize the capabilities of product R&D teams broadly enabling them to rapidly innovate AI-powered products.
